notes.title: 日本語のローカライズが完了しました！| Japanese Translation Is Here!
notes.notes:
皆さんこんにちは、お元気でしょうか。

日本語版『Sakuya Izayoi Gives You Advice And Dabs』と、にとりのDLCが登場です。

Steamの言語設定が日本語になっていれば自動的にダウンロードされますが、そうでない場合はSteamライブラリでゲームを右クリックしてプロパティを開き、言語タブから日本語を選択してください！

また、Steamを再起動することで表示される場合もあります。 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36687884/fbd628321e59618baf5444aa16570f809ccbc5ef.png[/img]

この翻訳が、あなたの助けになれば幸いです。
ぜひ感想をお聞かせください！

お気をつけて、素敵な一日をお過ごしください。

notes.title: 한국어 번역이 도착했습니다! | Korean Translation Is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, a Korean translation for Sakuya Izayoi Gives You Advice And Dabs has been added! I hope it will prove to be useful! 

To access the Korean version, right click the game, go to properties and select the Korean version from the languages tab, you may have to restart steam to see this, alternatively, if your steam is automatically set to Korean, the Korean version should be downloaded automatically.

As always, this only works with the base game and not the DLC, if you want to access the game in Korean you will have to disable the DLC. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36687884/71ed59c9029dc3717ae4cb6175e4b04be4c3cf0d.png[/img]

notes.title: Wriggle Nightbug is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36687884/f83106213f4c3468856da1db87ee4d96a3384b38.png[/img]

In this update for Sakuya Izayoi Gives You Advice And Dabs, Wriggle Nightbug joins Sakuya in giving you helpful advice! She has a thing or two to say about arguing about things! 

To access the content with Wriggle, head on over to the "Bonus Scene" at the end of the main game, and select the "Wriggle Wriggle" option at the end of the bonus scene! This scene works with either the DLC enabled (but the content is still only available through selecting the main Sakuya game) and is only available in English. You may have to restart steam for the update to take effect!

For more updates, please follow me on twitter!

 https://twitter.com/sigyaad

And of course, big thanks to the artist, Ryannthi for making the Wriggle artwork! You can check him out here: https://twitter.com/RyannThi

Thank you and have a wonderful day!

notes.title: New game! Dab on Darkness!
notes.notes:
Hello fans of Sakuya Izayoi Gives You Advice And Dabs!! The latest game, Dab on Darkness is available for wishlisting on steam now! 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332970/Dab_on_Darkness/

Confront your negative thoughts in this game through this short yet charming visual novel featuring cute art, a comfy soundtrack and engaging dialogue that aims to help you deal with those pesky intrusive thoughts you'd rather not have. How you choose to confront these feelings will also determine how the story ends!

notes.title: Russian translation is here!
notes.notes:
The Russian translation for Sakuya Izayoi Gives You Advice And Dabs is here! I would like to extend my deepest thanks to @CryPrism on twitter for providing this translation!

Like the other translations, the DLC must be disabled in order for it to work, if your steam language is set to Russian, the translation should automatically be assigned to your game, if not, simply go to the language tab via the properties menu in the game and select Russian![url=[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36687884/e0ef6638709c9d97f9a3dcdb97fe8482da1eab0b.png[/img]

notes.title: Spanish translation is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36687884/8cd8a8e02e9fc8b7c64de901d909cc91f1e23d86.png[/img]I'm happy to say that Sakuya Izayoi Gives You Advice And Dabs has now been translated to Spanish! Huuuge thanks to  @lHattyl on twitter for providing this translation!

The game should automatically be in Spanish if you have your language set to Latin American Spanish, otherwise, simply just right click the game, go to properties, and select the Spanish language from the language tab!

notes.title: Simplified Chinese is here!
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36687884/69f511a20f4c1158669cf6aa405e66583d5feacd.png[/img]The Simplified Chinese language has been added to the game! It should automatically be chosen for those who have Chinese as their default language, if not, simply right click the game, go to properties and select Simplified Chinese from the language tab!
